description: a half ball r 5 cut by the plane y = 0: the sphere face bounded by one meridian circle through both poles, its vertex at the north pole and its edge through the south, as NIST's FTC-06 writes face #351: the reader splits the edge at the pole it runs through, a vertex there, before any face is walked (ADR-0021), and the face is a (u, v) rectangle between the poles' degenerate edges. Shrunk from FTC-06 (ADR-0026 §4); Open CASCADE reads it, healed, to 2π·125/3
source: written by hand for this fixture, shrunk from NIST parts (ADR-0026 §4)
